what: Read an EmStanS Excel workbook — ess_read_excel
title: Read an EmStanS Excel workbook — ess_read_excel
text: Reads five-sheet EmStanS workbook (Setup, Panelists, Ratings, ItemMetaData, ExamineeMetaData) sheet name, falling back sheet position name found, returns [ess_data()].

title: Read an EmStanS Excel workbook — ess_read_excel
code: ess_read_excel(   path,   sheets = NULL,   levels = NULL,   sd = NULL,   ec = NULL,   columns = NULL,   quiet = TRUE )

title: Read an EmStanS Excel workbook — ess_read_excel
text: path Path `.xlsx` file. sheets Optional sheet names, named character vector `setup`, `ratings`, `items`, `examinees`. levels Level labels lowest highest. character vector applies every grade; named list gives labels per grade, example `list(R1 = c("E", "M", "L"), R2 = c("B", "P", ""))`. Overrides setup table. sd, ec Scaling SD essential-consistency threshold. single number applies every grade; named vector gives values per grade. Override setup table. Defaults SD = 1 EC = 0. columns Optional column mapping tables whose column names differ defaults. named list per table, named list vector input column names positions, example `list(ratings = list(item_id = "ItemID", level = 8))`. standard names : ratings `grade`, `round`, `table`, `panelist`, `item_id`, `level`; items `grade`, `item_id`, `domain`, `order`; setup `grade`, `levels`, `sd`, `ec`; examinees `grade`, `score`, `freq`. quiet `FALSE`, report column mapping used.

title: Read an EmStanS Excel workbook — ess_read_excel

title: Generate a Fake Data Set for Embedded Standard Setting — genFakeDataSet
text: ngca numeric value indicating number grade clusters GCAs generate. ntable numeric value indicating number tables generate within GCA. npanelist numeric value indicating number panelists generate within table. cor_val numeric value indicating intended correlation item locations aligned level descriptions. nlevel numeric value indicating number performance levels aligned level-description categories. sdinp numeric value used adjust standard deviation values used Weighted Embedded Standard Setting. Default `1`. ecinp numeric value used control essentially consistent items simulated item ratings. Default `0`. n numeric value indicating number items generate within GCA. ... Additional numeric arguments passed `runif()`, typically minimum maximum score values used generate item locations. example, `100, 300` generates item locations 100 300.

title: Bootstrap the modal cut scores of one unit — bootstrapping
text: x object class `"ESS"`. ... Former argument names, still accepted warning: `gca_name` (now `unit`) `boot_num` (now `n`). unit unit bootstrap, named `extract(x, "cutscore")`. n Number bootstrap samples. Default `100`. seed Optional random seed, reproducible draws. grid Candidate cuts sample: * `"items"` (default): sampled items' locations, exact   ESS minimum, estimator [emstans()] (`smooth = TRUE`   original fit, GAM-smoothed minimum). * `"jittered"`: evenly spaced grid location range (step   0.1 range 10, else 1), point randomly moved   one step, shared cut levels; cut minimum   GAM-smoothed inconsistency curve grid. earlier   EmStanS bootstrap.

title: bootstrapping
text: bootstrapping() resamples one unit’s items replacement (keeping location modal aligned level) re-estimates cut scores every sample. One unit time; seed makes draws reproducible. default sample uses sampled items’ locations candidate cuts takes exact ESS minimum, estimator emstans(). earlier EmStanS bootstrap, jittered grid candidate cuts GAM-smoothed minimum, available grid = "jittered":
